# Productization Requirements Checklist: Ready-to-Use Desktop App

**Purpose**: Validate whether the feature requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable for desktop productization before implementation planning.
**Created**: 2026-05-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are launch, setup, backend readiness, workspace entry, and retry requirements all defined as distinct user-facing outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001-FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK002 Are data-source detection, manual selection, invalid source, inaccessible source, and empty source requirements each documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002-FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are dashboard, browsing, message history, and search requirements all covered for loading, empty, error, and success states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007-FR-011, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK004 Are semantic configuration, index readiness, and QA streaming requirements separately defined rather than collapsed into one vague semantic feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012-FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Are graph MVP requirements complete for available data, no data, failed data, oversized data, and inspectable graph items? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §FR-015-FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Are settings, privacy controls, diagnostic export, and release caveat requirements all represented as first-deliverable product needs? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 6, Spec §FR-017-FR-024]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the first deliverable platform scope stated unambiguously as Windows x64, with macOS explicitly marked follow-up? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-023-FR-024]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the policy for occupied port `5030` clear enough to distinguish app-managed `chatlog_alpha` from unknown processes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006a, Spec §SC-002a]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "recoverable conflict state" defined with enough user-facing expectation to avoid silent failure or destructive cleanup ambiguity? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK010 Are privacy masking requirements explicit about what is hidden and what remains visible? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019-FR-019a, Spec §SC-008a]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the diagnostic package requirement clear that export is user-triggered and automatic collection is not allowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020a, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 Are semantic features clearly specified as optional and non-blocking for launch, dashboard, browsing, and search? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a, Spec §SC-006a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do sidecar lifecycle requirements align with the non-destructive port conflict policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004-FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK014 Do privacy, diagnostic, logging, screenshot, fixture, and release-note requirements consistently prohibit raw secrets and private message content? [Consistency, Spec §Privacy/Security Impact, Spec §FR-018-FR-020a, Spec §SC-008-SC-008b]
- [ ] CHK015 Do semantic optionality requirements align with P1 browsing/search/dashboard goals and avoid making provider setup a launch blocker? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-012a, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Do installable release requirements align with the Windows x64 first-deliverable clarification and avoid implying macOS blocks first delivery? [Consistency, Spec §Packaging Impact, Spec §FR-023-FR-024, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the requirement IDs and added suffix IDs traceable without conflicting or duplicating the same requirement meaning? [Traceability, Spec §Functional Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are launch and setup success criteria measurable enough to validate non-terminal startup and workspace entry? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001-SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Are search requirements measured from the user's perspective without relying on implementation-specific response details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 Are long-history browsing requirements quantified with a clear prepared data size and user-visible continuation expectation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Are privacy and diagnostic acceptance criteria strict enough to detect any raw secret or private content leakage in requirements review? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008-SC-008b]
- [ ] CHK022 Are release readiness criteria measurable for install, launch, quit, reopen, and manual backend cleanup avoidance? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009-SC-010]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery scenarios covered for first launch and backend readiness? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are no-data, no-results, invalid query, backend failure, and selected-conversation recovery scenarios addressed for browsing and search? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK025 Are semantic unavailable, running, failed, ready, interrupted stream, and empty-answer scenarios specified? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are graph available, empty, failed, malformed, oversized, and not-yet-generated scenarios represented in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are privacy mode activation while content is visible and diagnostics export while content is visible both addressed as distinct scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Are performance expectations specified for first launch, search feedback, large message history, streaming QA, and graph responsiveness? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-004-SC-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Are reliability requirements defined for backend startup, monitoring, shutdown, restart recovery, and unknown port conflict handling? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004-FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK030 Are observability requirements specific to safe diagnostic evidence without permitting automatic collection or private-data leakage? [Security/Observability, Spec §FR-020-FR-020a]
- [ ] CHK031 Are security and privacy requirements broad enough to cover logs, diagnostics, screenshots, fixtures, release notes, credentials, and message content? [Security/Privacy, Spec §FR-018-FR-022]
- [ ] CHK032 Are accessibility or localization expectations intentionally excluded, deferred, or missing from the first-deliverable requirements? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Are dependencies on compatible local WeChat data and compatible `chatlog_alpha` backend binary explicitly stated and testable? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Are assumptions about single-user local desktop use consistent with the absence of multi-user, remote, or telemetry requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK035 Are external AI provider assumptions bounded by explicit user configuration and semantic optionality? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012a, Spec §FR-022, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Are signing, notarization, and real-machine coverage caveats clearly bounded so they do not weaken Windows x64 deliverability? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-024]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 Is the phrase "safe diagnostic summary" specified enough to distinguish it from the required redacted diagnostic package? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-020a]
- [ ] CHK038 Is "meaningful dashboard statistics" defined with enough required content or acceptance criteria to guide planning? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK039 Is "small relationship graph" bounded with enough data-size or complexity expectation for requirements quality? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK040 Are "platform permission caveats" defined with enough scope to avoid hiding first-deliverable blockers in vague release notes? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]

## Notes

- This checklist evaluates requirement quality only. Items should be marked by reading and improving the spec, not by running or testing the implementation.
